title.narrative: Accelerating malaria control towards elimination by 2030 - Philippines (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Philippines, Malaria, Pilipinas Shell Foundation, Inc. (PSFI)This program has the following goals: By 2022, malaria transmission will have been interrupted in all provinces except Palawan 75 provinces will have been declared malaria-fre.. The number of indigenous malaria cases will be reduced to less than 1200, i.e. by at least 75% relative to 2018.. The objectives of this program are: To ensure universal access to reliable diagnosis, highly effective and appropriate treatment and preventive measures. (Service Delivery Guarantee). To strengthen the capacity at all levels to manage and implement malaria interventions. (HRH, standards, transparency, multi-sectoral action). To secure government and non-government financing to sustain malaria control and elimination efforts at all levels. (Financial Risk Protection Guarantee). To ensure quality malaria services, timely detection of infection and response and information and evidence to guide malaria elimination. (Quality, Data for Decision-Making, standards, performance accountability)
